name: Glyph burst
description: A phrase surrounded by / < > * // symbols at random angles, flying in and settling.

recipe.build: 8-14 spans with seeded rotate and translate, staggered in; centre phrase about 20 px; removed on the beat.

use_when: Code, feature or capability beats that need technical density.
avoid: Do not use for emotional beats; seed the angles (no Math.random).

code.example: RasanMoves.glyphBurst(tl, 0.2, { target: stage, phrase: 'make it weird', count: 12 });
